categories.evidence: Touches depends/hosts/darwin.mk and contrib/guix/symbol-check.py with Build system and macOS labels.
categories.rationale: Updates the macOS SDK version in depends and Guix symbol-check tooling to macOS 15.0 to satisfy upstream Qt platform requirements for an upcoming Qt 6.12 update. Per the PR description, 'Qt 6.12... requires the macOS 15 SDK or higher... This is a prerequisite for the upcoming update of Qt in depends from 6.8 LTS to 6.12 LTS.' Clear preparatory maintenance that unblocks future dependency upgrades without immediate urgency.
